task_definition.task_name: Recursive STA_LTA with Trigger Onset Plotting

task_description.overview: Retrieve waveform from FDSNWS, compute recursive STA/LTA, detect trigger onsets, and visualize results.
steps: Use FDSN client to fetch waveforms for a given station and time window.
Determine on/off sample indices with trigger_onset(cft, on_threshold, off_threshold).
Plot raw data with vertical lines at on/off times.
Plot cft with horizontal threshold lines.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using FDSN client, retrieve {network}.{station}..{channel} between {starttime} and {endtime}. Compute recursive STA/LTA with STA={STA_seconds}s, LTA={LTA_seconds}s. Use trigger_onset to find on/off indices for thresholds {on_threshold}/{off_threshold}. Plot the waveform with on/off lines and characteristic function with threshold lines. Save the 1D array trigger_cft to {trigger_cft} and the plot to {trigger_plot}.
